title: Simple machines
examples: Can you show me an example of a lever?
How is a pulley different from a wheel and axle?
Which simple machine helps you lift heavy things?

explain.say: Today we will learn about simple machines. These are simple tools that make work easier for us. We will look at four types today.

draw.text: Simple Machines: Lever, Pulley, Wheel & Axle, Ramp

explain.say: Now let me show you the real thing in 3D: a lever. Look at the fulcrum, the load and the effort. Tap any part, and I will tell you what it does.
A lever uses a rigid bar and a pivot point. Think about a seesaw; the middle point is the pivot. You push down on one end to lift the other.
A pulley uses a wheel and a rope to lift things. If you use a pulley to lift a bucket, you pull the rope down. This makes it easier to lift.
The wheel and axle work together like a doorknob. The wheel is the large part, and the axle is the smaller rod in the middle. Turning the wheel turns the axle too.

draw.text: Wheel & Axle: Large Wheel, Small Axle

explain.say: A ramp is a slanted surface that helps you move things up or down. It is an inclined plane. It is much easier to slide a box up a ramp than to lift it straight up.

draw.text: Ramp: Slanted surface for moving objects

explain.say: In real life, when you open a heavy gate, you might use a lever. The gate acts as the bar, and the hinges are the pivot point. This makes opening it much easier for you.

draw.text: Real Life: Opening a heavy gate

faq.q: What is the difference between a ramp and a slide?
faq.a: A ramp is a simple inclined plane used to move things up or down. A slide is usually a recreational structure for play.
asks: Is a slide a type of ramp?
What is the scientific name for a ramp?

faq.q: Do all simple machines use ropes?
faq.a: No, not all simple machines use ropes. For example, a lever only needs a bar and a pivot point to work.
asks: Do I always need a rope for pulleys?
What is the basic requirement for a lever?

faq.q: Can I use a wheel and axle for anything other than doors?
faq.a: Yes, bicycle wheels are excellent examples of a wheel and axle. The wheel turns, and the axle connects it to the frame.
asks: Where else do I see wheel and axle?

faq.q: Which simple machine is best for lifting something very heavy?
faq.a: A pulley system is often very effective for lifting heavy objects because it changes the direction of the force.
asks: Is a pulley always stronger than a lever?
What is the main job of a pulley?

faq.q: Is a seesaw always a lever?
faq.a: Yes, a seesaw is a perfect example of a lever. The person sitting in the middle acts as the pivot point.
asks: What is the pivot point on a seesaw?
Can a seesaw be considered a simple machine?

facts: A lever needs a rigid bar and a fixed pivot point to operate.
A pulley changes the direction of the force you apply to an object.
The wheel and axle system uses two connected circular parts.
A ramp is scientifically called an inclined plane.

quiz.say: A pair of scissors works like which simple machine?
quiz.show: Scissors use a pivot point and two arms
quiz.why: Scissors use two arms that pivot around a fixed point, which is the definition of a lever.

wrong.0: A ramp is a slanted surface used for sliding or rolling.
wrong.2: A pulley requires a wheel and a rope to change direction.
wrong.3: This machine needs two connected circular parts turning together.

quiz.say: If you want to move a heavy box across the ground, which machine is best?
quiz.why: A ramp reduces the force needed by turning the vertical lift into a gentle slope.

wrong.0: This system is best for rolling motion, not sliding up a slope.
wrong.2: A lever requires you to push down on one end to lift the other.
wrong.3: A pulley is better for lifting vertically using a rope.

quiz.say: A flagpole rope attached to a pulley system is best for:
quiz.show: Lifting a flag using a pulley
quiz.why: The main job of a pulley is to change the direction of the force applied to the load.

wrong.1: While it helps, its primary job is direction change, not always force multiplication.
wrong.2: A pivot point is what a lever needs, not a pulley.
wrong.3: While it changes distance, its most fundamental role is direction change.
